paraphrase: Asked whether any Ājīvaka goes to heaven, the Buddha says that recollecting the past ninety-one aeons he finds none except one, and that one taught the efficacy of deeds (kammavādī kiriyavādī); Vacchagotta concludes that this sectarian fold is empty even of heaven, and the Buddha agrees.
speaker: the Buddha
notes: Reported by an opponent: the Buddha (MN 71, Buddhist Pali canon). Section refs = SuttaCentral (bilara) segmentation, checked in the local e-text.
